svg.title: The public board cannot separate the 17 files of the final family: every difference to FD16P20 is within 1.1 paired standard errors

cc:Work.dc:title: The public board cannot separate the 17 files of the final family: every difference to FD16P20 is within 1.1 paired standard errors
cc:Work.dc:description: Dot plot of 17 files against public NDCG from 0.39436 to 0.39526. Pick 1, FD16P20@m0.4_0.2, is number 3 at 0.39521; pick 2, FDX16P20:ps, is highest at 0.39526; FD16P20 at 0.39489 is number 8 and carries the vertical reference line. Every other file has error bars of one and two paired standard errors, 0.00026 to 0.00056 per standard error, and every two-standard-error bar crosses the line at FD16P20. The largest differences are +0.00037 (+0.8 standard errors) and −0.00054 (−1.1).
